title: Pay
items: **W-2 or 1099?** As a 1099 contractor you usually pay both halves of Social Security and Medicare tax and get no employer health insurance, retirement match or paid leave.
**Raises:** is there a set annual raise, or is it negotiated each year?
**Extra shifts and late stays:** what does an extra shift pay? Are hours past your scheduled shift paid hourly, as comp time or not at all?

title: Schedule and call
items: **Shifts:** 8s, 10s or 12s? How many a week count as full-time?
**Weekends and holidays:** how many are you expected to work each year?
**Call structure:** a week at a time, or a day here and there? Weekend days, nights or both?
**Call logistics:** in-house or from home? If from home, how fast do you need to get in? Is call paid separately?

title: The job itself
items: **Scope:** will you do blocks, art lines and central lines? Cardiac, peds and OB cases?
**Sites:** can they send you to other hospitals or surgery centers, and how far away?
**Your employer:** a hospital, a private group or a national staffing company? What happens to your contract if your employer is sold or merges?

title: Benefits people forget
items: **CME:** how much money, and how many days off to use it?
**PTO and holidays:** accrued or granted, and when can you use them?
**Retirement:** how much is the match, and when does it vest?
**Disability insurance:** is it own-occupation, meaning it pays if you can no longer work as a CAA?
**License and dues:** does the employer pay for your state license, certification renewal and AAAA dues?
**Malpractice:** claims-made or occurrence? Who pays for tail coverage?

title: The fine print
items: **Non-compete:** how many miles, for how long, and measured from which site? Some systems measure from their farthest location.
**Termination:** is the notice period the same for both sides? Can they let you go without cause?
**Sign-on bonus or forgivable loan:** if you leave early, is repayment prorated or the full amount?
**Auto-renewal:** does the contract renew on its own, and how short is the window to opt out?

title: Save this for offer season.
